clips.title: The story
paras: Warlord Goretooth is the commanding orc officer stationed at Kargath in the dusty wastes of the Badlands. From his watchtower, he coordinates the Horde's frontier campaigns against the neighboring Dark Iron dwarves and monitors the volcanic menace of Blackrock Mountain. Though strict in military matters, he can occasionally be found relaxing around the camp's bonfire.

Perched atop the watchtower of Kargath, Warlord Lunk Goretooth directs Horde operations on the hostile eastern frontier. Kargath serves as Orgrimmar's primary staging ground against the threats lurking within Blackrock Mountain and the surrounding ravines. Goretooth oversees patrols, coordinates scout forces like the Kargath Expeditionary Force, and issues direct kill orders targeting the Dark Iron clan's ranks and leadership. When he descends from his lookout, the stern commander shows a lighter side, frequently warming himself by the camp bonfire and trading quips with the camp's Forsaken casters before returning to duty.

Goretooth views the Dark Iron dwarves as a clear and present threat to Horde interests in the Eastern Kingdoms. Rather than engaging in defensive posturing, he pursues aggressive war plans against General Angerforge and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's forces entrenched within Blackrock Depths. Recognizing the gravity of assaulting such an ancient subterranean stronghold, he frequently defers strategic matters to veteran orcs like Eitrigg in Orgrimmar, seeking seasoned wisdom before sanctioning further pushes into the mountain.
